reaction: The final cutaway brings the separate pieces together clearly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the colon to its blood vessels was worthwhile because it showed that water and some microbial products enter blood, while lining cells use other products.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final connection to the body felt mostly like assembly after the exchange had already been explained.

surprise.text: I expected to add blood vessels to the protected lining first, but the game instead combined it with the microbe-processed contents.

arbitrary.text: That required order felt a little arbitrary: the vessels seemed physically close enough to add earlier, although the compatibility hint showed what to do next.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: seeing how microbes, the lining and blood work together was interesting, even if the final assembly was predictable.
